_comment: Both bases, in this order. Expo's carries what the current SDK needs from
the compiler and changes with it; Chronologity's carries the strictness
every package in this repository is held to, and wins where they overlap.
`types` names jest explicitly. The shared base sets it empty because a
wide-open `types` pulls in whatever happens to be installed, and this
application is the one that needs a test runner's globals.
